02 / Recover · Blue Zone

Recover Series.
Product, Experience & Promotion.

Recover products and packaging were made as physical prototypes. Three participants with different sporting backgrounds experienced the collection in a gym setting. The RECOVER 15 proposal extends the product into premium gyms through a cooling-mist experience, spray trial and post-workout reset.
